title: HTML Structure, Syntax, and Doctype
description: Understanding the structure and syntax of HTML documents along with the doctype declaration.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the doctype declaration in an HTML document?
options: To declare the document type and version of HTML
quiz.correctAnswer: To declare the document type and version of HTML
quiz.explanation: The doctype tells the browser which HTML version to expect, helping it render correctly.

quiz.question: Which of the following is the correct syntax for the doctype declaration in HTML5?
quiz.explanation: The HTML5 doctype declaration is `<!DOCTYPE html>`.

quiz.question: In HTML, elements are made up of:
quiz.explanation: HTML elements consist of opening and closing tags, and may contain attributes.

quiz.question: What is the correct syntax for a self-closing tag in HTML5?
quiz.explanation: In HTML5, self-closing tags can be written as `` or ``.

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a correct way to write an attribute in HTML?
quiz.explanation: Attributes are written as name="value" or name='value', not with :=.

quiz.question: What character is used to close an opening tag?
quiz.explanation: Opening tags end with the '>' character.

quiz.question: Which tag pair correctly encloses the main content of an HTML document?
quiz.explanation: The `<body>` tag encloses all the visible content on the page.

quiz.question: Which of these is the correct nesting order of HTML elements?
quiz.explanation: The correct order is `<html>` root, then `<head>` and `<body>` inside.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the `<head>` section in HTML?
options: Contains metadata and links to resources
quiz.correctAnswer: Contains metadata and links to resources
quiz.explanation: The `<head>` contains meta tags, title, and links to CSS or scripts.

quiz.question: Which symbol is used to start an HTML comment?
quiz.explanation: HTML comments start with `<!--` and end with `-->`.
